title: Lab public site: Combine routes, layout, dynamic params, metadata, not-found decisions and accessible navigation into one small public-site contract
description: Next.js 16 and TypeScript 5 App Router lesson for lab public site. Includes an intentionally broken starter, a corrected contract, verified-path offline tests and official documentation.
objectives: Combine routes, layout, dynamic params, metadata, not-found decisions and accessible navigation into one small public-site contract.
Repair the intentionally failing next-public-site-capstone model.
Explain which behaviors need real Next.js compilation or browser integration verification.
rubric: I can explain lab public site in Next.js 16 without mixing older Pages Router semantics.
I can reproduce and fix the 07.01.08 failing starter with real data inputs.
I can identify the missing Next.js build, routing and HTTP integration evidence.
